# Quotation response -- DKS-2026-007

Visakoivu Oy

## 3. Eligibility

3.2 Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio per its most recent financial statements is 35.2%, exceeding the required 20% by a comfortable margin.

3.3 Visakoivu employs 48 sahko (electrical) professionals in its own workforce, exceeding the required minimum of 15.

3.4 Visakoivu holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate at the time of this quotation.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Our proposed HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement covers scheduled preventive rounds and responsive corrective works across the facility's mechanical plant, with visit frequency agreed at contract start and a written service record kept for each visit.

4.2 A site-specific occupational safety plan will be prepared for the facility prior to contract start, covering hazard identification and access arrangements.

4.3 Fire-protection systems will be maintained on a scheduled inspection and testing regime, with results documented after each visit.

4.4 Equipment installed under the contract carries a 24-month warranty from commissioning.

4.5 Waste generated on site is segregated at source and removed through licensed waste contractors, with documentation available to the buyer on request throughout the contract period.

4.7 Spare parts are held in stock for common items; parts not held are delivered within 3-5 working days.

4.8 Environmental matters during the works are managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 certified environmental management system, covering waste handling, spill prevention and material storage on site.

4.9 Our personnel will observe the buyer's access-control and site-security procedures as briefed at induction, including badge issuance, visitor logging and any escort arrangements the buyer specifies for contractor access to restricted areas.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Visakoivu's standard limitation-of-liability clause caps liability at the annual contract value per claim, in line with our standard commercial terms.

5.2 All prices are quoted in EUR.

5.3 We propose a retention of 5% on each invoice, released on satisfactory completion of the contract year.

## 7. Format

7.1 Pricing is quoted per square metre.

7.2 This quotation is submitted as a single PDF, not password-protected.

7.3 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year.

## Liite A

A.1 We offer SLA targets of 4 hours for critical faults and 24 hours for non-critical faults, measured from the time a fault report is logged.

A.4 Routine maintenance visits are scheduled monthly for mechanical plant, with content agreed with the buyer in advance and a written visit report left on site after each round.
